objective: Preallocate DDL table-operation index prefixes from table and column name lengths.

tasks.title: Preallocate DDL table index prefixes
tasks.result: DDL table index cleanup and secondary-index row-id rewrite paths now use explicit-capacity helpers instead of format! for index prefixes.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The table index helper reserves capacity for index:<table>: before pushing known components.
The column index helper reserves capacity for index:<table>:<column>: before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in DROP TABLE index cleanup, TRUNCATE TABLE index cleanup, and ALTER TABLE ADD PRIMARY KEY secondary BTree index row-id rewrite scan-prefix construction.
Added a SQL DDL regression that exercises ADD PRIMARY KEY after a secondary BTree index already exists.
Generated prefix bytes, scan_prefix inputs, deleted index keys, rewritten secondary index row IDs, and SQL DDL results are unchanged.
